response.goal: Build an n8n workflow that triggers on new responses from two Typeform forms, checks the Google Sheet for an existing row with the same email to skip duplicates, adds a new row with name, email, company, form name, and timestamp, posts a message to the #sales Slack channel with a link to the row, and emails if any step fails.

plan.step: Kickoff and requirements review to map the two Typeform forms to the data schema for Google Sheets.
Build the n8n workflow core with Typeform triggers, email-based duplicate check against Google Sheets, and conditional branching.
Configure the Google Sheets row creation and Slack notifications linking to the new row.
Implement error handling and notification emails for failed workflow steps.

milestones.name: Workflow Development and Duplicate Check
milestones.deliverable: Configured n8n workflow handling Typeform triggers and duplicate filtering against Google Sheets.

milestones.name: Integrations and Error Handling
milestones.deliverable: Fully tested n8n workflow with Google Sheets row creation, Slack channel alerts, and error email notifications.

risks.risk: Budget is specified as an hourly rate without a total project cap.
risks.mitigation: Establish a weekly hour limit or total estimated hours for the hourly contract.

risks.risk: Self-hosted n8n instance might have network or credential access limitations.
risks.mitigation: Verify Typeform webhook and Slack app permissions on the self-hosted n8n instance during kickoff.

questions: What email service or node do you prefer for the failure notification emails?
Do you already have Typeform webhooks and Slack credentials connected to your self-hosted n8n instance?
assumptions: The client has admin access to configure webhooks in Typeform and Slack.
The target Google Sheet already contains the required columns for name, email, company, form name, and timestamp.
